$comment: Typechecks the TEST sources, which tsconfig.json does not: its `include` is
['src/**/*'] only, so `npm run typecheck` has always been checking half the
TypeScript in this repository. Tests could drift from the code they exercise
-- wrong argument shapes, stale mock types, removed exports -- and nothing
caught it until an assertion happened to fail at runtime, or did not. See #1412.
This is a separate project rather than a widened `include` because tests need
vitest globals and looser rules than shipped source, and relaxing the main
config to accommodate them would weaken the checks on src/.
